benchmarks.description: ((1-Text Edit)*100 + Table TEDS + Formula CDM) / 3. Composite scores from PaddleOCR-VL/GLM-OCR/Qianfan papers (higher=better, max 100). Distinct from LLM-Stats version that reports inverse-direction edit-distance.

benchmarks.description: ANLS on 50K questions over 12K+ document images (UCSF Industry Documents). Updated 2026-06-14 (26 models).

benchmarks.description: DocVQA private test set ANLS. Updated 2026-05 (11 models).

benchmarks.name: ChartQA
benchmarks.description: 9.6K human + 23.1K generated questions over charts. Relaxed accuracy. Updated 2026-06-14 (24 models).

benchmarks.name: InfographicVQA-test
benchmarks.description: ANLS on infographic VQA. Updated 2026-06-14 (12 models).

benchmarks.name: CC-OCR
benchmarks.description: Comprehensive OCR: multi-scene text reading, multilingual reading, doc parsing, KIE. Updated 2026-06-14 (18 models, all Qwen).

benchmarks.name: TextVQA
